title: Brainstorm Receipt Extension
description: Extends receipt.base.schema.json. Module-specific fields for the Brainstorm module.

options_generated.description: Total ideas generated before convergence gate fired

options.description: Summary strings for top options surfaced to Propose. One per option.

evaluation_deferred.description: Must be true. false = evaluation occurred during generation (invariant BRN-1 violation).

top_options_path.description: Path to the top options file passed to Propose
